text:
Maya: FYI I temporarily disabled the column masking on the SIEM export for SEC-2345 so the triage team can correlate a chain of alerts. Doing this now to unblock reproductions; I know it touches retention/KMS/RBAC so starting this thread to coordinate controls and post-mortem. Export path: s3://redwood-siem/triage/SEC-2345/ (incident doc: https://redwood.in/incident/SEC-2345)
Ops-Lead: when did you flip it and how long is the window? were signed URLs used for external SOC access?
Maya: flip time 2026-03-22T23:05Z. We issued signed URLs to the external SOC for specific files; initial TTL was 6h. I requested Ops to issue as a fast path; verbal OK from Ops-Lead because triage blocked on auth bypass repro.
Sam: we need a tight audit trail before we let partners see unmasked content. Questions:
- who created the signed URLs and what principal executed the unmask transform?
- did any principal call KMS:Decrypt or were we just uploading pre-unmasked artifacts encrypted at rest?
Henry: also: lifecycle and retention for those artifacts. Default 90d is too long for this. Propose 14d for triage artifacts unless Legal objects.
security-bot: Automated note: export_id=siem-xk983 unmask=true by Maya @1722230000. Audit record created: audit-1722230000.
Maya: pipeline details: masking is a transform step in the exporter chain prior to upload. The exporter uses alias/redwood-siem-cmk to encrypt objects at rest. Service principal = svc-siem-exporter. We did NOT call kms:Decrypt for the external SOC; we gave them timeboxed signed URLs to the unmasked objects. Files currently have lifecycle rule = 90d.
Sam: immediate checklist:
- revoke all active signed URLs for triage/SEC-2345 and reissue 1h links only for files needed
- create temporary role role/siem-triage-analyst with MFA, 1h session max, and Deny for KMS decrypt/generateDataKey
- tighten S3 ACLs to only svc-siem-exporter + the temporary role during window
- shorten lifecycle for triage prefix to 14d and tag objects with incident=SEC-2345
- if CMK was used to wrap any artifacts that external parties might have, schedule CMK rotation in 48h
Henry: I can own the alerting side: add a monitor that opens a Sev1 if any unmask toggle happens without an active incident tag. Also create an automated rollback job to re-enable masking.
Maya: I'll open the RBAC PR for role/siem-triage-analyst with auto-expire. I'll add the deny snippet Henry suggested.
Sam: paste the AWS commands you ran and outputs (mask ARNs) into the incident doc, e.g.:
```
aws s3api list-objects --bucket redwood-siem --prefix triage/SEC-2345/
aws s3api get-object-acl --bucket redwood-siem --key triage/SEC-2345/session-20260322.json
aws kms get-key-rotation-status --key-id alias/redwood-siem-cmk
```
Maya: done — pasted outputs to the incident doc. Rotation status = Disabled; ACL shows svc-siem-exporter + ops-service-account as owners; no direct external principal in ACL.
Ops-Lead: actioned: revoke-signed-urls --incident SEC-2345 ; reissue procedure: 1h links only, logged to audit pipeline. ETA 12m. Reissue will include incident tag in the issuer log.
security-bot: Action logged: revoke-signed-urls by Ops-Lead @1722230100. Reissue id=url-985 created.
Legal-Review: we need the triage lead to confirm presence/absence of PII in the artifacts. If PII exists we must escalate and keep artifacts under restricted retention (180d) with narrower access; otherwise 14d is acceptable.
Maya: triage lead confirmed minimal PII (headers/IPs/trace IDs). I'll attach a scrub checklist. If Legal requests redaction we'll run a one-off scrub pipeline and regenerate artifacts.
Henry: RBAC deny snippet for inclusion in the temp role policy:
```
{
  "Effect": "Deny",
  "Action": ["kms:Decrypt", "kms:GenerateDataKey*"],
  "Resource": "*"
}
```
Sam: perfect. Also add explicit allow for s3:GetObject on the triage prefix and deny for s3:PutObject/DeleteObject for that role.
Ravi: I'm running the audit query now: siem-access --prefix triage/SEC-2345 --window 2026-03-22T22:00Z..2026-03-23T02:00Z ; will post counts and principals in 10m.
Maya: owners assigned: Maya = RBAC PR + incident doc; Ops-Lead = signed-URL revoke/reissue + lifecycle policy change; Sam = audit + policy review; Henry = alerts + rollback automation; Legal-Review = PII/retention sign-off. We'll meet for a 20m post-triage sync after reissue window closes.
Maya: closing note: I will lock down sibling export prefixes while we complete work and post a summary to #all-hands if there is org impact. Keep replies here and capture any follow-ups in SEC-2345. :white_check_mark:
